limitations: Private markers remain separate across support columns.
Base monomial columns have identical exponent profiles.
Every arbitrary support can be enlarged explicitly to meet these hypotheses.
Removing the private decorations or merging their marker variables is not proved to preserve regularity.
proved_application_scope: Balanced shared monomials with private marker exponent D>=6s; all orders and characteristic-zero coefficients.
Every finite nonnegative integer support admits an explicit balanced private enlargement.
Nonnegative rational polynomial templates with equal pure factorial moments; active-block window implies actual support-size SFC.
